One of Nirvana's technical departments suffered an unknown attack, resulting in 1 death and 1 injury. This incident caused a huge uproar in Eastside. To this day, the perpetrator remains at large, and no organization has claimed responsibility.

This incident drew significant attention from the Public Security Bureau, which launched a large-scale investigation. However, the attitude of Nirvana, the most affected party, towards the investigation has been...
Impossible. Absolutely impossible.
Aren't incidents like these quite common? Just some anti-social behavior that can't be avoided. Nirvana has already decided not to pursue it.
...surprisingly "relaxed."

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Let's not blow things out of proportion. First Mania, and now workplace bullying. I know the PSB has performance targets, but you don't need to slap such big accusations on Nirvana, right?

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: By the way, someone gifted me some nice coffee recently. Would you like a cup?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thank you, but let's not waste any more of each other's time.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You know very well whether or not I'm exaggerating.
You wave the dossier from the Public Security Bureau in your hand, refusing to accept their evasive response.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Public Security Bureau found a large amount of Mania residue at the crime scene, indicating that the incident likely involves Mania weapons or Sinners. This is a danger that Nirvana, and even Eastside, cannot underestimate.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Public Security Bureau sent me to investigate for the sake of Nirvana's security. As the head of a critical department, surely you will cooperate with us?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: After all, none of us want even more serious consequences due to negligence.
As if remembering something, the department head's professional smile freezes momentarily. After a brief pause, she spreads her hands, seemingly in compromise.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Honestly, there's no point in grilling me like this. I know what the Public Security Bureau wants. You're here to get "inside information" about the attack.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: I'm not trying to be uncooperative. Honestly, I just got transferred here, so I really don't know what you're looking for.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Moreover, with Mania and Sinners... how could such things be related to us? The attack on our department was clearly an isolated incident that no one could've predicted!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you suggesting that you don't believe the Public Security Bureau detected Mania residue at the scene?

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Of course not. But tests aren't always conclusive, right? I just have an inkling of doubt.
Though professional and polite, she flinches in denial at the mention of "Mania" and repeatedly claims to know nothing.
Like most Eastsiders, she has a strong aversion to Mania, which doesn't necessarily indicate dishonesty. You decide to change your line of questioning.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you know the victim of this case?

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: I've worked with him before. He used to be in charge of the department I'm heading now. An easygoing guy... witty conversationalist...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's quite different from what's circulating online. You must've heard the rumors about workplace bullying at Nirvana. They seem to be closely linked to the "easygoing guy" you mentioned.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How much do you know about the victim's daily life? His interpersonal relationships, workplace performance...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you familiar with his subordinates? How was his relationship with them? Regarding the "workplace bullying" rumors online, you...

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Oh, those are baseless rumors! Totally untrue! The Public Security Bureau has always been highly professional. Surely you wouldn't fall for such misinformation!
Upon hearing the words "workplace bullying," the department head immediately sits up to refute the rumors.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is a routine procedure. Please answer my questions.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: No, no, no... This concerns the reputation of the company. I must rectify them.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Abusing subordinates? Workplace bullying? Trust me, that's pure nonsense! Unlike other companies, we have a perfect supervision and complaint mechanism. Such incidents would never take place here.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Moreover, Nirvana gives its employees some of the best benefits in DisCity. Labor violations are unthinkable. Why do you think so many people want to join us?

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: If you still don't believe me, feel free to investigate, and we'll gladly assist. But I can guarantee that you won't find anything. It's less likely that you'll find something like that than even Mania weapons or Sinners!
She spews a long monologue with righteous conviction, exuding a newfound resolve that contrasts with her previous evasiveness. Her gaze locks onto you, seemingly in search of validation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I have no intention of making premature conclusions. Rest assured, this is just a routine inquiry.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Sorry, I got a bit carried away... As for the individual you mentioned... Indeed, there's nothing peculiar about him. He's just one of the many managers at Nirvana who cared deeply for their subordinates.
Seeing that you're unmoved, the department head bows her head and takes a deep breath. When she speaks again, her voice is raspy and trembling.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Such a shame to see this kind-hearted soul get vilified even after death... He gave up his life to protect his subordinates.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's the first time I've heard of such a claim. I haven't seen this mentioned in any related investigation reports.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Of course not! If it gets out, just imagine the uproar it would cause amongst the public.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: This matter has already caused too much panic. How can we destabilize public discourse even further? Therefore, Nirvana locked down this information.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: However, it seems our well-intentioned actions have instead attracted slander.
The department head rubs her temples and flashes you a weary smile.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: If you still have doubts about my words, I can ask the other party involved in the incident to come and testify.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Of course, you can ask her all your questions again. I also hope you get the answers you want to hear.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Surely you jest. What the Public Security Bureau and I want has always been the truth.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If she is willing to come forward, I have no objections.
The department head immediately sends out a message via her comms device. Soon, the other party she mentioned arrives at the meeting room.
You look up, surprised at who walked in.
The moment your eyes meet, a trace of surprise flashes across Rise's face. But she quickly composes herself and avoids your gaze.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: There you are. Please have a seat here.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: This is the employee that the former manager died to protect—Rise Blake. Though she's young, she's an outstanding Nirvana employee.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Because of that accident, she was injured and hospitalized for a week... am I right?
Though she asks this question, the department head keeps talking before Rise can answer.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: After returning to work, she isn't as talkative as before. Probably because she hasn't fully recovered from the attack. It's understandable; after all, it must be traumatizing to see your manager suffer because of you.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Ah, if he were still alive and knew how much the subordinate he cared for has grown, he would surely be delighted... But alas, life is unpredictable...
The department head keeps lamenting non-stop. You take a glance at Rise, who remains silent. You interrupt the monologue.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's get back to the investigation, so as not to delay Miss Rise's regular work.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Yes, yes, you're right. I tend to ramble on when I get emotional... Rise, this is the specialist appointed by the Public Security Bureau to investigate the incident. Don't be nervous. Just tell everything you know.
Next, the department head relays the content of your previous conversation to Rise, including the Mania residue found at the scene and the workplace bullying rumors online.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: But how could these be possible?
The department head loudly emphasizes this while frequently glancing at Rise. You notice the suggestive intent in her words and prepare to intervene.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: I agree with you. This attack is just a pure accident.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: My former manager, based on what I know about him through work, would never have anything to do with Mania weapons or Sinners.
Rise looks up, nods to the department head, and forces a dry smile. Having obtained the desired answer, the department head smiles almost impatiently at you.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: You heard her clearly, didn't you? I told you so...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: However, it's not because that scumbag was a good manager who protected his subordinates and sacrificed himself.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Quite the opposite...
Rise tears her compliant newbie facade to shreds. She leans back on the chair, her face full of scorn.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: He was a stubborn and self-serving idiot who never did anything useful. It's a miracle that his annual check-ups didn't reveal a lack of brain development.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Mania? Sinners? That brain of his couldn't even comprehend a project workflow. Where would he get the intelligence or capacity to meddle in these matters?
Sharp, precise, and hitting the mark. You are in awe of Rise's shrewd attacks.
Ignoring the forced smile of the department head, Rise takes out a recording pen, pushes it in front of you, and presses the play button.

steps.speaker: Nirvana PR
steps.content: ...As a party involved in the incident, I hope you'll tell the investigators everything you know. There won't be scheming or bullying. Just follow your heart and report everything truthfully...

steps.speaker: Nirvana PR
steps.content: ...It is your duty to protect company interests, Miss Rise... We all don't want things to get ugly...

steps.speaker: Nirvana PR
steps.content: ...You're still young, and have a bright career and future ahead of you. Nirvana appreciates loyal and outstanding employees like you, but if you can't properly assess the situation... you know what that would entail...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Of course, I know what that would entail.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: However, giving a false testimony that goes against my conscience is way above my pay grade.
Rise stands up, takes a stack of bound documents from her black briefcase and throws it in front of the department head.
The top sheet bears the words "Resignation Report" in bold black letters.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: This is my response.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: You... you...!
The humiliated department head stutters like an unplugged radio, too furious to string together a sentence. Rise gently places a pen on her right side.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: If you don't want the recording to be leaked, you'd better sign quickly and let me go today.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Otherwise, I can't guarantee that this recording won't suddenly become front-page news.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: After all, we all don't want things to get ugly, right?

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: ...Very good, Rise Blake. You've really outdone yourself.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: Where do you get the confidence to threaten your superior with a fabricated recording?

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: At your age, where do you get the nerve to slander the company like that? You...
The conversation veers away from the investigation. As you watch the two of them face off each other, you vaguely feel that Rise is using you as a stepping stone for her resignation.
You sigh to yourself, pick up the recorder from the table, and stand up.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Isn't it a bit too hasty to label the recording as "fabricated" right now, ma'am?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As an impartial third party, I'm very willing to transfer the recording to the Public Security Bureau for examination.

Judging by what happened today, the Nirvana higher-ups will continue to evade questions about the attack. They neither believe nor care about the truth behind the case. They only care about controlling public opinion.
Conventional questions will only get you the answers Nirvana wants you to hear. To uncover the source of the Mania at the scene, you need a lever to pry open the chest of secrets.
Luckily, Rise gave you one.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If the recording is verified, it proves that Nirvana indeed pressured employees to conceal information related to the case. I believe the Public Security Bureau will take some tough measures once they confirm this.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: By then, Nirvana will be dealing with a much tougher investigation style.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: ...That was an illegal recording! It has no legal validity. The Public Security Bureau has no right to do this!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're right. But the attack had great social impact. Due to external pressure, the Public Security Bureau needs to periodically update the public on the investigation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thanks to your help today, this recording is my only gain so far. I have to include it in the investigation progress report. If it gets publicized, what do you think will happen?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course, everything I say is based on the assumption that the "recording is real." So you don't need to worry too much, right?
Rise's resignation request is approved.
Drenched in cold sweat, the department head signs Rise's resignation request, pulls some strings to bypass red tape, and lets her leave the company that very day.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: ...On the day of the attack, a glitch caused the department to lose all surveillance data from the meeting room. We don't know any more about the incident than the Public Security Bureau does.

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: No matter how many times you ask, I will still say the same thing: Nirvana has nothing to do with Mania, or the so-called Mania residue you mentioned!

steps.speaker: Department Head
steps.content: I have nothing more to say. If you have any further questions, I'll get Nirvana's legal team to communicate with you...
Today's investigation comes to nothing. You fail to obtain any effective leads related to the Mania residue at the scene.

Although the attitudes of the department head and Rise indirectly confirm that workplace bullying indeed existed involving the victim in the case, the key link connecting this matter to Mania is yet to be found.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: I should say "long time no see" to you, MBCC Chief.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: But judging by the time, the next thing I should say is "goodbye."
When you and the now resigned Rise walk out of the Nirvana building, it's precisely the time when employees get off work.
You recall the unreserved contempt Rise showed when mentioning her former superior in the meeting room. A few questions suddenly arise in your mind.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Before we part, may I ask you a few questions?

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Sure, but please be quick. After all, it's my off time already.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In your view, how did your other colleagues get along with your former manager? Were they like you?
Upon hearing your question, Rise squints behind her glasses.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: I only have working relationships with my colleagues. I don't discuss personal matters, so I'm not sure how they got along with him.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: As for whether they're like me...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Chief, please be frank. Are you suspecting me?
Bathed in the sunset, her face exudes a coldness that contrasts with the warm tones.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Sorry to disappoint you. When the attack happened, I was knocked out by a blow to the head.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: When I woke up in the hospital, the medical staff said I barely escaped because I was shielded by some collapsed debris.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: After the incident, Nirvana transferred me to the Cybersecurity Center to minimize the impact on public opinion, as well as to keep me quiet. You know the rest.
Rise responds swiftly and concisely. She seems to have erected an invisible barrier between you. Your intuition tells you that you won't be able to get any more information from her today.
However, recalling the excessive Mania residue at the scene, you can't help but ask one more question.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did you notice anything unusual when the attack happened?

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: This is the last question. I'm off now.
As soon as she finishes speaking, Rise strides forward without hesitation, her long upright shadow trailing behind her in the sunset.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: By the way, Chief... I still need to thank you for today.
She suddenly stops and turns around. With her back to the light, you can't quite make out her expression.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Thanks to your help, I was able to leave Nirvana smoothly.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: I've wanted to leave this toxic place for a long time. It's time to find... a more ideal job.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes, indeed. The next job will be better.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I wish you all the best. I hope the next time we meet, I'll hear good news from you.
A brief silence passes between you and her. After a moment, as if by some agreement, you hear her quiet reply.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...Alright then, goodbye.
